 From dawn cafes to K-fashion and skincare, ultra-close travel to Seoul for 24 hours
BC card payments, the number of tourists per day is clear I put myself on a night flight after work on Friday. When you arrive at Incheon International Airport after midnight, instead of checking in at the hotel, you will be glued to the spa near the airport for a while. I enjoy freshly baked bread and coffee in the morning and fall into fashion and cosmetics shopping during the day. In the afternoon, they get skincare treatment and eat Korean-style meat in the evening. After scanning the night streets of Hongdae, we head back to the airport.
 사진 확대 Foreign tourists on a trip to Korea / Photo = BC Card It is a trip to Korea by Mai Kawaguchi (34) who works for an information technology company in Tokyo, Japan. It is a so-called "0 nights and 2 days" trip that saves money on accommodation and invests in shopping, gourmet and beauty experiences. It has recently attracted attention among young Japanese office workers by starting Friday night and returning full Saturday night.
 Travel Plus reconstructed Mai's day with BC Card payment data. When the actual payment trend was overlapped, the consumption map of Japanese tourists visiting Korea was expanding to cafes, fashion, skin care, and restaurants.
 Midnight...a trip from Incheon International Airport 사진 확대 a foreign tourist / photograph = BC Card 0:30 a.m. After arriving at Incheon International Airport, Mai headed to the spa around the airport. I relieve the fatigue of long-distance travel and prepare to move to Seoul. When you arrive downtown, you leave your carrier in an unmanned locker at a station or shopping mall. This is the first mission to start the day with a lighter body.
 According to BC Card's payment data from January to September 2026, the number of Japanese people who visited the spa around Incheon International Airport has steadily increased. In particular, the number of payments for unmanned storage boxes increased by more than 100% from the previous year. Consumption data also captured the method of traveling through the city center using rest facilities and leaving luggage instead of lodging.
 7 a.m…Follow the smell of bread to Jongno-ro 사진 확대 Foreign tourists visiting the bakery cafe in Jongno-gu, Seoul / Photo = BC Card 사진 확대 Foreign tourists visiting the bakery cafe in Jongno-gu, Seoul / Photo = BC Card The first destination is Jongno's popular bakery cafe. The savory butter scent spreads from freshly baked bread, and in front of the display stand, it slows down to choose the menu that has been noticed on social media. After taking pictures while enjoying coffee and bread, we move to a hanok cafe. Enjoy green tea and salt bread under the tiled roof and wooden pillars, sharing the old scenery and new senses of Seoul.
 BC Card data shows that foreigners account for half of the payments at famous bakery cafes in Jongno-gu from 7 a.m. to 9 a.m. Some cafes account for more than 60% of Japanese payments among foreigners. Cafes have now become a travel destination and a stage for creating SNS content beyond coffee drinking spaces.
 9:30 a.m.…A bowl of hangover soup in Seongsu-dong 사진 확대 Gamjatang / Photo = pexels "I was recommended to have bone hangover soup or seolleongtang for breakfast." After arriving in Seongsu-dong, Mai visits a gamjatang restaurant 24 hours a day before the pop-up store opens. Steam rises from the boiling earthen pot, and the thick soup contains plenty of gently cooked meat. Eat the flesh from the bones, roll the rice into the soup, and take a spoonful of it to complete a hearty breakfast.
 When I finish eating, I start shopping in Seongsu-dong. Enjoy cream bread and Americano at a sensuous dessert cafe and explore new products around fashion and beauty pop-up stores. When you participate in a sampling event, products that you were only going to look at are already in your shopping bag. Seongsu-dong, which enjoys brands, spaces, and experiences at once, attracts short travelers.
 noon...Open a Wallet for K Fashion and K Beauty 사진 확대 Foreign tourists looking around pharmacies / Photo = Maekyung DB From noon, the pace of shopping becomes faster. After looking around Korean designer brands in Hannam-dong, they move to Myeong-dong to find fashion platform stores and popular brands. Try on the new autumn products stored online and choose your favorite clothes. BC Card data shows that the number of payments from street fashion brands popular with Japanese tourists has increased dozens of times year-on-year.
 After shopping, I get skin care procedures and stop by nearby pharmacies. It goes beyond buying cosmetics and clothes and experiences Korean beauty services firsthand. According to the Ministry of Health and Welfare, 2.01 million foreign patients visited Korea in 2025, exceeding 2 million annually for the first time since 2009 when related statistics began to be compiled.
 BC Card's data for the first half of 2026 also showed that the amount of foreign tourists using medical institutions increased 98% from the same period last year. Skin beauty increased by 109.8% and pharmacies increased by 1,177%. This is why consumption, which binds tourism, shopping, and medical and beauty services to one schedule, is drawing attention.
 5 p.m…I'm recharging my energy with pork ribs 사진 확대 Pork ribs / Photo = Unsplash 5 p.m. Stamina reveals its bottom, but the shopping list is still there. Cosmetics, mask packs, and gift yakgwa that became a hot topic on Japanese SNS are also included in the shopping basket. The dinner menu is pork ribs. As the meat cooks over the charcoal, the sweet seasoning scent spreads, and the sizzling sound stimulates appetite. Eat ripe meat with lettuce, garlic, and ssamjang, forgetting the fatigue of the day for a while.
 According to BC Card, Japanese payments at a chicken restaurant have steadily increased. Recently, Japanese payments have risen by more than 40 percent at pork ribs, K-barbecue, and rice soup restaurants. Korean food is becoming a local experience beyond the means of solving meals during travel.
 8 p.m…The last flame in Hongdae 사진 확대 The crowded streets of Hongik University. [Maekyung DB] The last destination is Hongdae. The streets are mixed with music and people's laughter, and the lights sparkle in every store. They also enjoy spicy and sweet tteokbokki, crispy chicken gangjeong, and sweet chocolate acai bowl. Cell phones are full of photos of cafes, shopping, and food. Mai edits dozens of photos into short videos and posts them on social media. "My feet are stiff and my whole body aches, but my mind is 100% charged."
 10:30 p.m. After returning to the airport on a late-night bus, Mai finishes her last shopping at the duty-free shop while waiting for boarding. However, there are places where the payment method that was used familiar in Japan does not work, and language communication was also difficult. The shorter the trip, the more important it is to increase the convenience of use, such as payment, transportation, and multilingual guidance.
 The number of Japanese visiting Korea is increasing...Attention to the flow of consumption 사진 확대 Foreign tourists / photos at Incheon International Airport = Incheon International Airport According to the Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism, about 15.05 million foreign tourists visited Korea between January and August 2026, up 21.6% from the same period last year. The number of visitors to Korea reached about 2.25 million in August. Japanese tourists are also on the rise. Between January and July 2026, about 2.28 million Japanese visited Korea, 18.8% more than the same period last year. In BC Card data, the monthly payment amount of Japanese people also increased 114% from January 2025 as of September 2026. The cumulative payment amount between January and September 2026 also increased 35% from the same period last year.
 An official from a travel agency specializing in foreign tourists said, "Traveling where you can experience taste, gourmet food, beauty and culture at once in a short time is Korea's only charm. We need to think about whether Korean tourism can provide a variety of experiences that we want to visit again after a day beyond how many tourist destinations it shows."
